allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select whether another caster illusion, private phantasm, sound-only image, disguise shell, illusory creature or class-created illusion qualifies. Bind actual source identity, ownership/permission and material access without importing an own-illusion-only gate silently. The spell does not by itself supply an absent original illusion.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Partially real supplies no dimensions, mass, material, object HP/AC, anatomy or physical traits.
allQuestions.options: A: actual bounded material/object subset with a complete physical profile. B: finite temporary creature/structure options with separately complete profiles.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose supported extent/quantity and exact derivation or authored statistics. Include collision, support/load, breakage, manipulation, reach and existing volume placement. Retain substantive real utility such as a functioning support/tool/barrier where selected. A purely cosmetic overlay is insufficient. Any exclusion of creatures, weapons or damage is NEW and must be explicit, not imported from another game.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Realization can overlap existing matter, bodies, held gear and the underlying depicted terrain.
allQuestions.options: A: prevalidated empty-space creation with explicit attachment exceptions. B: bounded occupied-space transformation with exact saving/placement rules.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select collision checks, separation, anchoring, legal shape, moving support, actual cargo and ownership. Do not duplicate the real body/item beneath a disguise, crush creatures by unresolved overlap or erase original terrain. Positive occupied-space or equipment examples require a genuine permitted branch, not invented free disarming or transfer.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source grants1minute, while the underlying illusion can end, move, be disbelieved or have its own concentration.
allQuestions.options: A: reality remains dependent on the source illusion. B: the selected part persists independently for its own fixed minute.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose exact resolution deadline, concentration if added, owner death/absence, source editing/movement/ending and independently scoped dispel/suppression. If the same caster needs two concentrations, supply a real granted route or select a coherent nonconcentration overlay. True Seeing identifies illusion without automatically canceling actual material; state which real properties survive recognition.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Temporary real matter can be moved, sold, used as crafting stock or consumed as a component before it ends.
allQuestions.options: A: time-bound real matter with explicit provenance through use/consumption. B: functional temporary manifestation with specified nonstock/consumption restrictions.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select actual permitted uses and restrictions; do not silently ban all useful interactions to avoid bookkeeping. Track fragments/containers/ownership, transformed products, real work done, worn equipment and genuinely consumed resources. No reset, permanent minting, duplicated unique item or refund without authored authority. State what ends at60seconds and what legitimate consequences persist.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A real weapon, barrier, trap or creature could deal damage or participate in an already existing illusion payload.
allQuestions.options: A: explicit real profile with its own legal actions/damage roots. B: narrowly functional nondamaging material with expressly authored exclusions.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Resolve whether existing psychic damage/conditions remain alongside physical use; no double credit or proc from one event. Shadow Blade supplies one actual wielded weapon with holder ownership, while Spectral Army has fake attackable images and independent finite blasts; neither default applies wholesale. A new real creature needs actual autonomy/command/initiative, costs and positive profile evidence.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Losing temporary support or worn/held matter produces real body/equipment consequences.
allQuestions.options: A: source-local ending/suppression removes the physical manifestation. B: retained-body suppression with unusable properties and lawful resumption.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select the actual lifecycle and preserve original clock/custody/HP/history. If support ceases, use accepted Falling and actual landing damage; if suppression resumes, require legal placement and never retroactively undo a fall. Resolve multiple realizations of one source part and replacement without resetting consumed matter or stacking hidden duplicate bodies.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Target is forced to fight a version of themselves for3rounds; source supplies no location, opponent ontology, resistance or target-type limit.
allQuestions.options: A: a real source-local reflection body in the existing encounter. B: a target-private apparent opponent with explicit real combat consequences. C: a separately authorized bounded encounter space.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose the useful actual fight and its initial resistance/admission. Neither title nor school extracts a soul, creates a Heartcell, severs ownership or establishes a new plane. Any actual relocation requires explicit full travel/custody/return rules. Do not replace fight with a harmless image or a no-op rejection path.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A version of the target has no printed stat fraction, CR cap, equipment, knowledge or repertoire model.
allQuestions.options: A: snapshot actual current target profile with named bounded exceptions. B: an explicitly authored reflection transformation retaining recognizable target capabilities.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select exact HP/current versus maximum, abilities, defenses, size, form and spell/attack sources. No invented half-HP fraction, boss exclusion or borrowed generic Mirror Beast as if printed. Supply actual complete profiles for positive cases; missing arbitrary monster actions remain content holds. Copy appearance is not automatic copy of secret memories, credentials, unique artifacts or source soul identity.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Forced fighting can replace player decisions or spend scarce actions/resources; existing hard-control interfaces remain operative.
allQuestions.options: A: adversarial focus with explicit retained target choices. B: compulsory actions with exact hard-denial spending and bounded followthrough.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify target movement/attacks/spells, refusal/inability, allies/other threats, repeat saves and hostile defenses. If a whole Action/turn is denied/replaced, reconcile the existing once-per-source-target-encounter guard explicitly; do not erase three-round usefulness by ignoring its later rounds. Never force self-harm or arbitrary resource surrender by an assumed generic compulsion rule.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Three rounds does not establish opponent initiative, action budget or command ownership.
allQuestions.options: A: a defined independent opponent schedule. B: a source-attached phase with expressly permitted combat actions.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose who directs the reflection and its legal action/movement/Reaction budgets, initial activation and three exact future markers. Handle targets with attached phases/no ordinary turn, extra turns, initiative changes and noncombat timing without double ticks or invented turns. Any owner-wide companion exception must be explicit; a target-copy is not automatically the caster existing companion.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Target resources and equipment may be duplicated; reflection damage and healing may be real or subjective.
allQuestions.options: A: finite snapshot resources/temporary equipment with actual independent payment and outcomes. B: bounded simulated capability envelope with exact mapping to real damage/resources.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select spent-versus-full pools, limited-use histories, concentration, action/counter windows and effect ownership. No rest/resource refresh, transferable loot, permanent copied companion or free charged artifact. Specify normal/temporary HP, damage roots, Null eligibility, defenses, wound thresholds and whether each combatant can be healed or harmed by outsiders.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The fight may end by victory, death, escape, source removal, suppression or the3round deadline.
allQuestions.options: A: terminate fight and temporary opponent with specified durable combat consequences. B: a distinct ending matrix with actual return/recovery rules.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose target/reflection0HP and death ordering, concentration loss, unconscious target, death saves, carried original items, suppression/resumption and unresolved actions. Real damage is not automatically refunded; no resurrection, essence capture or Hunted exception is implied. Prevent an indefinite trap while preserving exact legal agency and rescue paths.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Parallel reflections, copied reflection spells and True Seeing can interact with the chosen opponent model.
allQuestions.options: A: explicit finite target/owner/lineage instance limits. B: multiple opponents with complete action/economy/ending arbitration.
allQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: State what is NEW instead of inheriting Simulacrum or Mirrorsage limits. True Seeing must follow actual source type: recognition alone is not antimagic or denial of a real body. No reflections of reflections, replayed paid activations or duplicate resource entitlements unless explicitly supported by terminating rules. Keep accepted-but-unapplied rules, pending Simulacrum and unaccepted Rank8 wall distinct.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Actual perception, personal recognition, initial conviction, attack redirection and physical consequences have distinct predicates. A known-false test against an already expired image does not prove the intended rule.
allQuestions.request: Use live visible source applications and genuine observer-specific acquired knowledge for all recognition/conviction tests, with exact source image and actual caster positions. Give separate true Action/Reaction/provider and payment records for each attempted attack/cast; an unspent wallet alone does not authorize an off-turn Action. Define one authoritative attack/cast lineage for multi-roll and miss-gate decisions and show independent real occurrences, not just duplicate callback rejection.

allQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Useful real support, copied combat ability and broad spell imitation require concrete source-derived positive behavior and actual finite body/resource provenance. Pending comparison drafts are not current accepted procedures.
allQuestions.request: Preserve complete native child and actor profiles, exact selected NEW adaptations, real utility and damage, finite copied inventory and elapsed deadlines. Explicitly reconcile source/overlay concentration, physical custody, independent recognition and source-local suppression without granting duplicate paid resources or global immunity to True Seeing. Keep current accepted contexts distinct from every unresolved candidate, including Magic7 until independently applied.

Actual useful nondamaging physical/healing/utility imitation, independent observer disbelief and True Seeing, Ready/concentration/countering and finite lineage/expiry with real remaining consequences.
Genuine battlefield-scale visual mirror and enemy attacks under exact selected two-roll interpretation, initial saves, natural1/20 and actual adv/disadv/reroll provenance.

Multiple real attackers and independent multiattacks, new/returning observer histories, live overlapping images, True Seeing/nonvisual senses and automatic/save spell distinctions with one damage event per attack.
Positive hostile effect with chosen outgoing/incoming50percent gate, independently paid successful and failed events, one stored random lineage and actual physical/support model.

Real spell-attack/multiray/area/persistent event variants with precise gate granularity, payment/concentration retained through failure, suppression/recast/expiry and no duplicate gate or invented plane transit.
Actually useful materialization of part of a real source illusion with exact physical profile, support/load/carry/actions, owner and original resource provenance.
Independent real material use and live observer recognition, source ending/suppression, allowed fragments/consumption/damage and true60second expiry with actual unsupported fall and finite custody.
Complete real target and selected reflection profiles in a useful three-round fight, exact initial admission, actual phases/actions/compelled decisions and finite copied resources.
Second actual fight with meaningful agency, outside intervention/defenses/Null, victory or zeroHP, exact suppression/expiry and original inventory/body cleanup without loot or healing reset.

originalFutureCaseRequirementsUnchanged.requirements: At least two fully sourced positive imitations: one genuine damaging/control spell and one useful nondamaging physical/healing/utility spell under the selected model. Include concrete belief success/failure, two observers with different knowledge, actual components/costs, countered outer/child where applicable, midstack repricing, Ready/concentration, True Seeing/disbelief and ending. Every child has actual source/profile/access adapter; no invented generic payload.

Two positive battlefield encounters with real enemy observers and attacks. Include exact chosen two-roll math, natural20/1, advantage/disadvantage/reroll, independent multiattack, lawful save timing, enemy entry/exit, nonvisual senses/True Seeing, automatic-hit and area-save nonattack branch, actual cover and an overlapping illusion.

Two positive engagements showing a failed and retained qualifying event with explicit gate direction and one saved random lineage. Include spell-attack duplicate-gate prevention, multi-ray/area/automatic-hit/beneficial/persistent cases, actual payment, Null roots, suppression timing and physical support. Use a genuine qualified public-die/Fate Coin branch only if that actual event is exposed.

Two positive useful materializations from actual existing source illusions, with exact dimensions, mass, HP/AC, support/carry/equipment and real actions. Include independent observer disbelief/True Seeing, original source ending, suppression/resumption, fragmentation/consumption if admitted,60second expiry and actual unsupported Falling. Include an actual damaging profile only if selected, with no invented source weapon.

Two positive three-round fights using complete real target profiles and selected reflection derivations, not only rejection branches. Trace initiative/actions/RNG, hard-control history and remaining target agency, spent resources, damage/defenses/Null/concentration, observer interventions, target/reflection0HP or victory, exact expiry/suppression and inventory cleanup. Preserve any genuinely missing profile as a separate explicit content hold.
